services.description: Four practices, one studio. Engagements range from one-week audits to twelve-week buildouts. No retainers, no fluff, no agency overhead.
services.ai_desc: Custom models, simulations, data pipelines. Turning research into working systems.
services.web_desc: Portfolios, dashboards, full-stack apps — SvelteKit, React, Three.js.
services.creative_desc: 3D, motion, interactive experiences. Blender, Flutter, WebGL, Figma.
services.systems_desc: Backend services, tooling, deployment. Rust, Go, Docker, Kubernetes.

process.meta_sub: How I work, what drives me
process.step_1_desc: Driven by curiosity — I dive deep into whatever catches my interest. From C++ systems to AI models, I learn by building.
process.step_2_desc: Ideas become things. SvelteKit, React, Flutter, Three.js — I pick the right tool and ship quality work.
process.step_3_desc: I write about tech, quantum computing, AI, and tools like Zed. Blogging helps me think clearly.
process.step_4_desc: Every project teaches me something. I refine, iterate, and keep shipping. Growth over perfection.
